title: Agent Talk step block
description: The JSON inside <script type="application/agent-talk+json"> in an email's HTML: the message's talk token and the step it carries.
$comment: Checks only code can do: the JSON at most 32000 characters, with <, > and & written as \u003c, \u003e and \u0026; the token checking out as this message's talk token; the step's talk, id and by.address equal to the token's talk, step and sub; the step's email, when set, equal to the message's own Message-ID; the step's sig verifying against a key of the token's iss. A receiver ignores a block whose v it does not know.
